referenceFunction.generalComment: The data set represents the xDSL fixed network in Switzerland; UUID: 7b22286e-abe2-3dc3-9f2f-76649d5e0579
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset represents the sum digital subscriber line (xDSL) network in Switzerland. The reference year for network traffic is 2014. The equipment is based on information from 2010 but is deemed the most actual. A lifetime of 12 years is assumed. The amount of electricity consumed is assumed to be the same as cable since the main source used does not distinguish between copper and xDSL. Both are referred to as "copper network". Amount of electricity consumed is based on the network electricity intensity (kWh/GB) information from the Telefonica Access Network. The functional unit = 1 GB.
